technical-summary: Lab benchmark host-link-duplex: per card, pull (host->GPU) and push (GPU->host) alone, serial vs duplex by kernels and by hipMemcpyAsync, each beside a CU-bound compute stand-in. First run: tail 6900 XT link ~3.6 GB/s each way, copy-engine duplex 1.06x the slower direction and no slowdown of concurrent compute; kernel transfers add ~0.5 ms to concurrent compute.
user-summary-candidate: A new lab benchmark shows whether a graphics card's slow link can carry data in both directions at once without slowing its compute.
